textbookText: Exercises A. Multiple choice questions 1. Which of the following is an example of a molecular solid? a. Sodium chloride b. Diamond c. Iodine d. Copper 2. What does efflorescence substances do? a. Absorb moisture from the air b. Lose water of crystallization on exposure to air c. Dissolve readily in water d. Form a crystal lattice structure 3. In the process of crystal growth, what is the term for the addition of new particles to the surface of a crystal? a. Nucleation b. Sublimation c. Lattice formation d. Deposition 4. Which type of solid allows for high electrical conductivity in molten and aqueous form? a. Molecular solid b. Ionic solid c. Metallic solid d. Covalent network solid a. The smallest portion of the lattice is known as a) Lattice structure b) Lattice point c) Bravais crystal d) Unit cell 5. Diamond is an example of a. solid with hydrogen bonding b) electrovalent solid c) covalent solid d) glass 6. Which property of the following is shown by crystals with water of crystallizations? a. Hygroscopic b. Anhydrous c. Deliquescent d. Efflorescent 7. Which of the following factor is not responsible maintain the size and quality of crystal during crystal growth? a. Pressure b. Concentration of solution
